description:
The root folder of the drive. Read-only.

TIP: Gets the root folder driveItem of a drive (from get-user-drive). Returns the root item id, name, folder.childCount, and webUrl. Pass the root item id to list-drive-children to enumerate top-level files and folders.

RISK LEVEL: MEDIUM. This response contains PII or authentication metadata (sign-ins, MFA factors, mail metadata, risk detections). Handle with care and avoid casual disclosure.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-drive-root
